messages:
priya: quick heads-up — I'm opening a PR that wires a per-env release gating toggle and a small k8s overlay for the gate in prod/staging. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/842

andrew: what exactly does the gate do? is it a header check, annotation, or an admission hook?

priya: it's a config-driven rollout gate. high level: we add a small deployment (release-gate) that validates incoming rollout requests and consults a feature flag + k8s label policy. goal is to block full rollouts unless gate passes. Config lives in overlays/{dev,staging,prod}/release-gate.yaml and a TF var "release_gate_enabled".

marta: put a snippet of the k8s overlay? easier to reason about on PR.

priya: sure — here's the overlay patch I'm proposing:
```yaml
# overlays/prod/release-gate.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: release-gate-config
data:
  gating_mode: "strict"   # values: off, permissive, strict
  allowed_labels: "release=true,canary=true"
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: release-gate
spec:
  replicas: 2
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: gate
        image: registry.internal/redwood/release-gate:sha-1a2b3c
        env:
        - name: KMS_SECRET_PATH
          value: "projects/rw-kms/secrets/release-gate-key"
```

liam: thanks. two quick Qs: 1) are we adding any new IAM roles for the gate to read secrets? 2) TF var name? currently PR uses `gating_enabled_prod` which feels inconsistent.

priya: good catch. IAM: yes, gate needs read access to the KMS key secret. I'm reusing the existing service account `infra-gates@redwood.iam` and adding the role `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`. TF var: happy to rename to `release_gate_enabled` (bool) and a map `release_gate_mode = { dev = "off", staging = "permissive", prod = "strict" }`.

security-bot: quick policy scan: the KMS path referenced must be approved by secrets team. please add a secrets review label on the PR and include rotation policy. Also ensure the gate's SA is limited to decrypt only, not list.

marta: nit: in the configmap keys, can we call it `mode` instead of `gating_mode`? keeps it shorter and matches other overlays.

priya: happy to change to `mode` — I'll update the YAML and TF defaults.

andrew: one more nit: the deployment image should be pinned to digest; GH link shows sha but the YAML above uses tag. make it `image: registry.internal/...@sha256:...`

liam: I'll run `kustomize build overlays/staging | kubectl apply -f - --dry-run=client` and smoke the admission path. ping me once PR is updated and I'll do a local canary test.

priya: PR updated with var rename and digest pinned. also added the secrets review tag. link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/842 (updated)

devops-bot: preview cluster created: preview-842-staging (ttl: 2h). Kustomize build succeeded.

marta: ran the dry-run, no CRD changes. lgtm from infra side, one doc nit — add a sentence to overlays/README about gating lifecycle.

security-bot: approved with comments — please ensure SA principle of least privilege and include the rotation window (we recommend 90d).

andrew: LGTM pending liam's canary smoke.

liam: smoke passed on preview cluster. I'll do a 10% canary in staging for 15m then promote.

priya: thanks team — I'll merge after the canary is green and coordinate a prod deploy window. leaving a TODO to add an alert in console for gate failures. :thumbsup:

devops-bot: canary rollout scheduled: staging -> 10% for 15m (start: 1769013200).

priya: merging now. I'll tag ops-channel when prod window is scheduled.
